steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract song titles and artists
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the header line
song_lines = lines[1:]  # first line is "# Songs for Spotify Playlist"
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Split on " by "
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title
        songs.append({'title': line, 'artists': []})
print(songs)

for song in songs:
    song_id = find_song_id(song['title'], song['artists'])
    if song_id is not None:
        result = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=song_id, access_token=access_token)

        added_count += 1
    else:
        print(f"Could not find '{song['title']}' by {', '.join(song['artists'])}")

print(f"Total songs added: {added_count}")
